description: FastAPI backend main module implementing API routes for user registration, authentication, note CRUD operations, search, and health check. It includes route definitions, middleware setup, database session handling, and dependency injections.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Main application instance for defining the API.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Dependency generator for obtaining a database session, ensuring proper closing.

methods.name: register(user: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new user with validation against existing email or username.

methods.name: login_token(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user credentials and generate a JWT token.

methods.name: read_users_me(current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current authenticated user details.

methods.name: create_note(note: schemas.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new note associated with the current user.

methods.name: list_notes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all notes of the current user, ordered by last edit date.

methods.name: read_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by ID if owned by the current user.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note: schemas.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates a specific note if owned by the current user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a specific note if owned by the current user.

methods.name: search_notes(q: str = Query(..., description="Search string in title or content"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Searches within the user's notes by substring in title or content, ordered by last edited.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint to verify API health status.
